title.narrative: Contribution 2026 to the Special Fund for Emergency and Resilience Activities (SFERA) of the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) - Top Up 2026 - 2026/02

description.narrative: SFERA is the FAO’s humanitarian emergency and rehabilitation fund, enabling rapid and efficient interventions in food and agriculture-related crises, in both acute and chronic emergency situations. The mechanism combines working capital, a revolving fund, and programmatic funding to support timely response and preparedness. Dankzij het goed functionerend humanitair donorfonds SFERA is FAO in staat om snel en efficiënt te interveniëren in de meest kritieke fase van een noodtoestand. FAO ondersteunt de getroffen bevolking in het beschermen en herstellen van hun primaire levensbehoeften en helpt de meest kwetsbare bevolking om zich beter voor te bereiden op rampen en meer weerbaarheid op te bouwen.

The contribution aims to provide flexible and unearmarked funding to enable the rapid mobilization of resources for time-critical interventions, thereby safeguarding food production and food security. This is intended to maximize efficiency and prevent a further escalation of humanitarian needs, particularly during critical planting seasons. Thanks to SFERA, the FAO was able to intervene rapidly during critical crisis moments, supporting affected populations in protecting and restoring their livelihoods and strengthening their resilience. The approach—with a strong emphasis on local procurement and timely agricultural support—delivers high returns and efficient impact for every euro invested.
